senses.gloss: (anu-ṣaṭ) adv. [enumerated in svarādigaṇa, GaṇPā. 254. 40; and in cādigaṇa, GaṇPā. 85. 129] in continuous order or one after another, MW; in continuous or close order, APTE, cf. अनुषक्, अनुषज्.
(anuṣaṭ-ghaga) n. the syllables gha and ga used with the first six letters continuously क्रमात् न्यसेत्। भालोदरहृद्गभतूपतले…मूर्धन्यनुषट्घगावन्तु मनुम् PañcaRā.(Nā.) iii. 4. 9.
